pairs.target: dìyīliàng chē láishí , tǎ wéi hái méi bǎ bǐ tāochū lái .
pairs.english: When the first cart arrived, Tavi had not even taken out his pen.
pairs.hanzi: 第一辆车来时，塔维还没把笔掏出来。

pairs.target: kàn lù de nǚrén yǐjīng jǔqǐ duǎn mùpái , jiào chēfū xiān tíng zài cāng qián .
pairs.english: The woman managing passage had already raised a short wooden sign and told the driver to wait before the warehouses.
pairs.hanzi: 看路的女人已经举起短木牌，叫车夫先停在仓前。

pairs.target: tā shēnpáng de nánrén zǒu dào chēwěi , rào le yìquān , huílái tóng tā diǎntóu .
pairs.english: The man beside her walked to the cart's rear, circled it, and returned with a nod to her.
pairs.hanzi: 她身旁的男人走到车尾，绕了一圈，回来同她点头。

pairs.target: liǎnggè rén dōu shì shū yàn zuórì qǐnglái de běndì gōng , shōugōng yǐhòu lìng yǒu yìlán jì qián , bú zài hè zhǎngguì shǒuxià zuòshì .
pairs.english: Both were local workers Shuyan had hired yesterday, with a separate pay column after work, not employees under Shopkeeper He.
pairs.hanzi: 两个人都是舒砚昨日请来的本地工，收工以后另有一栏记钱，不在贺掌柜手下做事。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi rènchū nàliàngchē tóng qiánrì bǐ guò chǐcùn de chàbùduō , zhèng xiǎng shuō kěyǐ , nǚrén yǐ cóng huáilǐ chōuchū yì jié shéng ,
pairs.english: Tavi recognized a cart much like the one measured two days earlier and was about to approve it, but the woman had drawn a length of cord from her coat,
pairs.hanzi: 塔维认出那辆车同前日比过尺寸的差不多，正想说可以，女人已从怀里抽出一截绳，

pairs.target: jiāng xiāng jiǎo shēnchū de dìfāng liáng guò , jiào chēfū bǎ duō chūlái de yìgēn héngmù xièxià .
pairs.english: measured the crate's protruding corner, and told the driver to remove an extra crosspiece.
pairs.hanzi: 将箱角伸出的地方量过，叫车夫把多出来的一根横木卸下。

pairs.target: chēfū shuō zhǐshì shùnshǒu tìrén dài de , chōudiào máfán .
pairs.english: The driver said it was only an extra favor for someone and troublesome to remove.
pairs.hanzi: 车夫说只是顺手替人带的，抽掉麻烦。

pairs.target: nǚrén méi tóng tā zhēng , zhī shuō chōudiào zài lái , hòutou xiān děng zhe , bùxǔ wǎng shíjiē kǒu jǐ .
pairs.english: The woman did not argue, only said to remove it and return; those behind must wait and must not crowd the steps' entrance.
pairs.hanzi: 女人没同他争，只说抽掉再来，后头先等着，不许往石阶口挤。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng bǐ wòzhù , zuò huí huà le quān de dìfāng pángbiān ; tā jīnrì jì de shì rén děng le duōjiǔ , búshì tì tā hǎn fàngxíng .
pairs.english: Tavi gripped his pen and sat beside the marked circles. Today he recorded people's waiting time, not passage calls on her behalf.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将笔握住，坐回画了圈的地方旁边；他今日记的是人等了多久，不是替她喊放行。

pairs.target: héngmù xièxià yǐhòu , chē mànmàn guǎijìnqù .
pairs.english: Once the crosspiece was removed, the cart turned in slowly.
pairs.hanzi: 横木卸下以后，车慢慢拐进去。

pairs.target: lúnzǐ zài fěn jì wài cā chū yídào xīn de huī yìn , tǎ wéi kàn dé yìshí wàng le xiě , děng chē guòqù , cái tīngjiàn bì lán zài hòutou hǎn tā ràng yi ràng .
pairs.english: The wheels scuffed a fresh gray mark outside the chalk. Watching, Tavi briefly forgot to write; only after it passed did he hear Bilan behind him asking him to move.
pairs.hanzi: 轮子在粉记外擦出一道新的灰印，塔维看得一时忘了写，等车过去，才听见碧岚在后头喊他让一让。

pairs.target: tā gǎnjǐn suō tuǐ , bēilǒu cóng xī qián guòqù , fàn guàn zhàojiù pèng chū qīng xiǎng .
pairs.english: He hastily drew in his legs. The basket passed his knees, its food pots clinking softly as usual.
pairs.hanzi: 他赶紧缩腿，背篓从膝前过去，饭罐照旧碰出轻响。

pairs.target: tā méi tíngxiàlái kuā tāmen , zhī cháo kàn lù nǚrén shuō jīnrì dìyītàng yǒu rètāng , hòutou nà liǎnggè rén ruò yě yào chī , dé zǎoxiē liú wǎn .
pairs.english: She did not stop to praise them, just told the passage woman her first delivery included hot soup; if the two behind wanted some, they must reserve bowls early.
pairs.hanzi: 她没停下来夸他们，只朝看路女人说今日第一趟有热汤，后头那两个人若也要吃，得早些留碗。

pairs.target: nǚrén diǎntóu , lìkè zhuǎnxiàng xià yíliàngchē , wèn zhuāng de shénme .
pairs.english: The woman nodded, immediately turning to the next cart to ask its cargo.
pairs.hanzi: 女人点头，立刻转向下一辆车，问装的什么。

pairs.target: dìèrliàng bǐ dìyīliàng kuài , dìsānliàng què dào dé wǎn .
pairs.english: The second was quicker than the first, but the third arrived late.
pairs.hanzi: 第二辆比第一辆快，第三辆却到得晚。

pairs.target: lún dào tā shí , záhuòpù lǐ yǐ lái le yìtǒng xǐ guò cài de shuǐ , pù zhǔ zhèng tóng rén tái zhe , yào cóng ménqián sòng qù hòuyuàn .
pairs.english: When its turn came, the general store had a bucket of vegetable-washing water. The owner and a helper were carrying it through the doorway to the rear yard.
pairs.hanzi: 轮到它时，杂货铺里已来了一桶洗过菜的水，铺主正同人抬着，要从门前送去后院。

pairs.target: chēfū méi kànjiàn tǒng , xiān cuī kāi ménbǎn , pù zhǔjiàng tǒng luò zài dìshàng , shuō zìjǐ zǒng bùnéng bào zhe shuǐ děng tā xièwán .
pairs.english: The driver missed the bucket and demanded the door panel be opened. The owner put the bucket down, saying he could not hold the water until unloading finished.
pairs.hanzi: 车夫没看见桶，先催开门板，铺主将桶落在地上，说自己总不能抱着水等它卸完。

pairs.target: yìbiān yào jìn , yìbiān yào guò , shuí yě búshìgùyì lái dǔ de .
pairs.english: One wanted entry, the other passage; neither meant to obstruct.
pairs.hanzi: 一边要进，一边要过，谁也不是故意来堵的。

pairs.target: hè zhǎngguì cóng cāng lǐ chūlái , xiān wèn chē zěnme wǎn le . chēfū shuō shàngtóu zhuāngxiāng shí shǎo zhǎochū yìzhī , děng le bàngè zhōngtóu , nándào xiànzài háiyào zài fá tā děng .
pairs.english: Shopkeeper He came out and first asked why the cart was late. The driver said a missing crate uphill had cost half an hour; must he now be punished with more waiting?
pairs.hanzi: 贺掌柜从仓里出来，先问车怎么晚了。车夫说上头装箱时少找出一只，等了半个钟头，难道现在还要再罚他等。

pairs.target: " búshì fá . " kàn lù nǚrén shuō , " nǐ zǎoxiān nà yì gé shíchén guòqù le . "
pairs.english: “Not punishment,” the passage woman said. “Your earlier time slot has passed.”
pairs.hanzi: “不是罚。”看路女人说，“你早先那一格时辰过去了。”

pairs.target: chēfū wàng zhe ménqián kōng chūlái de dìfāng , liǎnsè réng bùhǎo .
pairs.english: The driver stared at the free space by the door, still looking displeased.
pairs.hanzi: 车夫望着门前空出来的地方，脸色仍不好。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yuán xiǎng xiě " chídào ", bǐ luòxià yòu tíngzhù , tiān le " zhuānghuò děng xiāng ". tā kànbújiàn shàngtóu fashēng guò shénme , zhī zài pángbiān zhùmíng shì chēfū shuō de .
pairs.english: Tavi meant to write “late,” then paused and added “waiting for a crate during loading.” He had not seen what happened uphill, so noted it as the driver's account.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维原想写“迟到”，笔落下又停住，添了“装货等箱”。他看不见上头发生过什么，只在旁边注明是车夫说的。

pairs.target: pù zhǔ tái tǒng shí chě le yíxià yāo , jiào lái de rén yě jí zhe huíqù .
pairs.english: The owner strained his back lifting the bucket, and the helper was in a hurry to leave too.
pairs.hanzi: 铺主抬桶时扯了一下腰，叫来的人也急着回去。

pairs.target: kàn lù nánrén fàngxià mùpái , guòqù dā yìbǎ , tǒng xiān cóng nà bànshàn mén lǐ sòngzǒu , luòdì de shuǐ zài ní lǐ tuō chū yìtiáo liàngxiàn .
pairs.english: The passage man put down his sign and helped. The bucket went through the half-open door first, spilled water drawing a bright line in the mud.
pairs.hanzi: 看路男人放下木牌，过去搭一把，桶先从那半扇门里送走，落地的水在泥里拖出一条亮线。

pairs.target: chēfū děng le hǎo yíhuìer , zhōngyú chóngxīn qiānchē , guǎijìnqù shí réng gūnóng , dānwù de shíchén suàn shuí de .
pairs.english: After waiting a while the driver finally led his cart in again, still muttering about who would bear the lost time.
pairs.hanzi: 车夫等了好一会儿，终于重新牵车，拐进去时仍咕哝，耽误的时辰算谁的。

pairs.target: hè zhǎngguì méi jiào tā bìzuǐ , zìjǐ zài mùtiáo bèihòu yòu jì le liǎngháng .
pairs.english: Shopkeeper He did not silence him, but wrote two more lines on the wooden strip's back.
pairs.hanzi: 贺掌柜没叫他闭嘴，自己在木条背后又记了两行。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànjiàn , tā jì de búshì shuí bùtīnghuà , érshì xià yìpī chē jìn shì yǐqián , cāng lǐ yào xiān bǎ kōngxiāng liú qí .
pairs.english: Tavi saw she was noting not disobedience, but that the warehouses must prepare all empty crates before the next batch entered the market.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看见，她记的不是谁不听话，而是下一批车进市以前，仓里要先把空箱留齐。

pairs.target: nàgēnmù tiáo yǐjīng kuài xiě mǎn , xiàng yìzhī bèi fǎnfù bǔguò de zhǎi ménbǎn .
pairs.english: The strip was nearly full, like a narrow door panel patched over and over.
pairs.hanzi: 那根木条已经快写满，像一只被反复补过的窄门板。

pairs.target: dào wǔqián , dìyī zǎo zhī jìn le sìliàng . chē méiyǒu kǎzhù shíjiē , bì lán yě zǒu wán le liǎngtàng , kěhè zhǎngguì yuánběn pàn de shì liùliàng .
pairs.english: By noon, only four carts had entered that first morning. None blocked the steps and Bilan completed two trips, but Shopkeeper He had hoped for six.
pairs.hanzi: 到午前，第一早只进了四辆。车没有卡住石阶，碧岚也走完了两趟，可贺掌柜原本盼的是六辆。

pairs.target: tā jiāng zhàng tān gěi shū yàn kàn , wèn hòu liǎngliàng shìbushì yòu dé rào qù biéchù xiè .
pairs.english: She spread her accounts for Shuyan and asked whether the last two had to detour elsewhere to unload again.
pairs.hanzi: 她将账摊给舒砚看，问后两辆是不是又得绕去别处卸。

pairs.target: shū yàn jiào tā bǎ míngzǎo de zhuānghuò shíchén yìqǐ dàilái , bùnéng guāng ná ménkǒu zhè yíduàn suàn .
pairs.english: Shuyan told her to bring tomorrow's loading times too, not calculate from this entrance alone.
pairs.hanzi: 舒砚叫她把明早的装货时辰一起带来，不能光拿门口这一段算。

pairs.target: shōubǐ shí , tǎ wéi cái fāxiànzìjǐ de jiǎo biān yípiàn huī , huàquān de fěn yǐjīng cǎi dàn le .
pairs.english: Putting his pen away, Tavi noticed dust all around his feet; the chalk circles were worn faint.
pairs.hanzi: 收笔时，塔维才发现自己的脚边一片灰，画圈的粉已经踩淡了。

pairs.target: tā wānxiàqù bǔ , xiǎng zhào yuánlái de yàngzi miáo yuán , yù hé zhǐzhe pángbiān de xīn jiǎoyìn , shuō nàbiān cái shì rén zhēn zhàn guò de dìfāng .
pairs.english: He bent to redraw them round as before. Yuhe pointed to fresh footprints beside them: that was where people had actually stood.
pairs.hanzi: 他弯下去补，想照原来的样子描圆，郁禾指着旁边的新脚印，说那边才是人真站过的地方。

pairs.target: tā bǎ zhǐ shàng liǎnggè zhěngqí de quān gǎi dé wāi le yìdiǎn , xīnlǐ jìng qīngkuài xiē .
pairs.english: He made the two neat circles on paper a little crooked and felt oddly lighter.
pairs.hanzi: 他把纸上两个整齐的圈改得歪了一点，心里竟轻快些。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng lái shōu jìlù , kànguò shuō xiàwǔ búzài jiā yìlún , xiān bǎ jīnrì kàn míngbái de xiě wán ; hòu rì de gōngfū yě pái hǎo le , míngwǎn tā kěyǐ qù luó dí jiā chīfàn .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng collected the records and said there would be no extra afternoon round: finish today's observations first. The day after tomorrow was scheduled too; tomorrow evening Tavi could eat at Luodi's.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡来收记录，看过说下午不再加一轮，先把今日看明白的写完；后日的工夫也排好了，明晚他可以去罗荻家吃饭。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi táiqǐ tóu , wèn shìbushì hái gǎndeshàng zuìhòu nà kuài ròu . ruǎn héng méi tīngdǒng , tā biàn zìjǐ xiào qǐlái , shōu hǎo bǎnzǐ , pǎo dào jiēkǒu tuōrén gěi luó dí dài huà .
pairs.english: Tavi looked up and asked if he could still make it for the last piece of meat. Ruan Heng did not understand; Tavi laughed, put his board away, and ran to the street entrance to send Luodi a message.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维抬起头，问是不是还赶得上最后那块肉。阮衡没听懂，他便自己笑起来，收好板子，跑到街口托人给罗荻带话。
